projection.separate: Three halfspaces g_i dot delta <=0, with gradient rows normalized independently. Positive component weights do not change each separate halfspace.
projection.aggregate: One halfspace for gradient of30*generic_JSD+100*chat_JSD+10*ordinary_CE, normalized after summation; cancellation between components is possible.
projection.nominal_update: Take exact current FP32 parameters before usual AdamW step and measure stored after-minus-before displacement, including adaptive preconditioning, moment state and weight decay.
projection.solution: Closest Euclidean displacement satisfying chosen homogeneous halfspaces. Enumerate all active sets for at most3 normalized constraints; solve small FP64 Gram system with pseudoinverse where needed; verify primal/dual/KKT conditions. No silent fallback.
projection.publication: Apply corrected FP32 parameter values, then remeasure actual stored displacement and component dot products. Roll back parameter values and abort before checkpoint if numerical gate fails; no failed-step continuation.

numeric_bound.expression: Each chosen normalized gradient dot stored_delta <= absolute + relative*L2norm(stored_delta)

projection.optimizer_state: Adam moments remain from unprojected proposal; disclose this. Reproject each later proposed update.
projection.target_progress: Derive weighted target gradient from total gradient minus protected component gradients; record target gradient dot nominal/stored delta.
